name: ConFiQA
description: ConFiQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate context-faithfulness of large language models in Retrieval-Augmented Generation scenarios with knowledge conflicts. It tests LLMs' ability to produce responses faithful to provided context, simulating real-world retrieval and alignment challenges.
reputation: A relatively recent but increasingly used benchmark for retrieval-augmented generation faithfulness, especially in studies of context conflict and hallucination.
notes: Simulates RAG scenarios with knowledge conflicts to evaluate context-faithfulness; used to improve alignment methods.
